research_question: Is the tapered quantile calculation implemented faithfully, and how does its error compare with untapered quantile regression in a small screen?
scope: One deterministic reference calculation followed by ten paired Gaussian simulation datasets of size 200.
scope_justification: The reference check precedes a small baseline comparison; this screen cannot establish broad improvement or asymptotic validity.

claim_tests.hypothesis: Does the implementation reproduce an independently calculated reference solution?
claim_tests.design: Evaluate one deterministic input with a known reference solution, comparing coefficients in absolute units.
claim_tests.falsification_rule: Pause if absolute coefficient discrepancy exceeds 1e-8.
claim_tests.relevance_markdown: Check the implemented calculation against a reference before interpreting comparisons.

claim_tests.hypothesis: How does coefficient error compare with the untapered baseline in the small Gaussian setting?
claim_tests.design: Run both methods on the same ten generated datasets and report errors, paired differences and elapsed time.
claim_tests.falsification_rule: Report no observed advantage if the selected method has no lower mean error; ten repetitions cannot establish a general benefit.
claim_tests.relevance_markdown: Judge whether the preliminary accuracy justifies further computation.

estimand.name: maximum absolute coefficient error
estimand.mathematical_definition: The supremum over the quantile grid of the absolute difference between the estimated and true coefficient vectors, in Euclidean norm per coordinate.
estimand.target_population_or_distribution: The declared Gaussian simulation distribution at sample size 200.
estimand.aggregation: Mean coefficient error across ten paired datasets.

data_or_simulation_unit.unit_definition: One dataset of n iid observations with a scalar covariate and a continuous outcome generated under the setting-specific design.
data_or_simulation_unit.sampling_or_generation_process: Gaussian errors with a linear quantile structure and scalar standard-normal covariate.
data_or_simulation_unit.independence_structure: Datasets are independent across seeds; both methods receive the same dataset within each seed.
data_or_simulation_unit.splits: No sample splitting; the estimator and bootstrap use the full dataset.
data_or_simulation_unit.preprocessing: Covariates are centered and scaled to unit variance before estimation.

baselines.name: untapered quantile regression
baselines.rationale: It is the natural ablation: identical objective without the taper sequence, isolating the contribution of the taper.
baselines.implementation_identity: reference quantile regression solver, pinned version tag qrref-2.4.1
baselines.tuning_policy: No tuning parameters; the solver runs at default settings.
baselines.compute_budget: Same per-replicate compute envelope as the candidate method.

verification_checks: unit test reproduces the untapered solution when taper weights are set to one
deterministic seed check reproduces one full replicate bitwise
implementation_strategy.route_rationale: The frozen tapered objective requires custom model code; this is the first project implementation, not reuse of prior verified project code.

tuning_budget.selection_data: No data-dependent tuning in this feasibility screen.
tuning_budget.search_space: One prespecified taper setting from the frozen method.
tuning_budget.optimization_rule: Use the frozen setting without optimization.
tuning_budget.compute_limit: 600 elapsed seconds including checks and comparison.
tuning_budget.fairness_rule: The baseline receives the same replicate count and compute envelope as the candidate.

metrics.name: absolute reference discrepancy
metrics.definition: Maximum absolute coefficient difference from the independently calculated solution.
metrics.uncertainty_method: Not applicable to the deterministic reference calculation.

metrics.name: maximum absolute coefficient error
metrics.definition: Supremum of per-coordinate absolute estimation error over the quantile grid.
metrics.uncertainty_method: Monte Carlo standard error across independent datasets.

repetitions_and_uncertainty.random_seed_policy: Record seeds 1 through 10; reuse each seed across methods.
repetitions_and_uncertainty.interval_or_error_method: Report Monte Carlo standard errors for mean errors and paired error differences.
repetitions_and_uncertainty.target_precision: No precision target is claimed from ten repetitions; all estimates are exploratory.

multiplicity.family_definition: A deterministic verification followed by one exploratory comparison.
multiplicity.decision_rule: Describe observed differences without claiming statistical significance or general superiority.

stopping_rules.condition: The elapsed-time budget reaches 600 seconds or the reference check fails.
stopping_rules.action: Stop new work and ask the researcher how to proceed, preserving all completed and unrun cases.

leakage_checks.risk: Outcome-driven tuning could inflate apparent improvement.
leakage_checks.procedure: Check the recorded taper setting equals the frozen prespecified choice.
leakage_checks.failure_action: Pause for researcher instruction and retain affected results as invalidated.

decision_thresholds.criterion: Maximum absolute reference discrepancy is at most 1e-8.
decision_thresholds.interpretation: Passing supports this implementation check only; failure pauses comparative work.

decision_thresholds.criterion: Report the mean error difference and its uncertainty without a confirmatory cutoff.
decision_thresholds.interpretation: The exploratory contrast informs whether a larger study is worth authorizing.

data_sources.label: Deterministic reference inputs
data_sources.description_markdown: Planned deterministic reference check; this structural example does not retain or claim a completed reference solver. The retained README makes that limitation explicit.
data_sources.mapping_markdown: Declared covariate/outcome arrays and coefficients use the same standardized units as the selected method.

data_sources.label: Independent Gaussian simulation datasets
data_sources.description_markdown: Illustrative S1: $X_i\sim N(0,1)$, $Y_i=1+X_i+\epsilon_i$, with independent $\epsilon_i\sim N(0,1)$, so $Q_{Y|X}(\tau|x)=1+x+\Phi^{-1}(\tau)$. S2 uses independent $t_5$ errors and location $1+x$. The retained source computes population quantiles independently of any fitted estimator. Independent seeds generate independent datasets; neither bootstrap draws nor internal solver fits increase that count. Only S1 at n=200 is planned for this feasibility example.
data_sources.mapping_markdown: x is a unitless covariate and y is an outcome in declared outcome units. Preserve the centering/scaling transformation in target comparisons; no researcher-supplied actual dataset is represented.
